description: This file defines the BadResponseException class in the GuzzleHttp library, representing an exception thrown when an HTTP error response (4xx or 5xx) is encountered.

classes.name: BadResponseException
classes.description: An exception class that indicates an HTTP error response (4xx or 5xx) has occurred.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with message, request, response, previous exception, and handler context.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Indicates that this exception always has an associated response.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the associated ResponseInterface object, narrowing return type from the parent class.
